summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss widened to $63.0M from $54.4M.
The net loss widened to $59.5M, or −$4.40 per share, from $52.7M. Operating cash flow was −$51.8M and free cash flow −$51.9M, versus −$51.2M.
sources: OnKure Therapeutics, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: We face many risks and uncertainties, as more fully described in Part I, Item 1A, under the heading “Risk Factors.” Some of these risks…
Our management has concluded that substantial doubt exists as to our ability to continue as a going concern
We have incurred significant net losses in each period since inception…
We have never generated revenue from product sales and may never achieve or maintain profitability
We are substantially dependent on OKI-219
We have limited resources and are currently focusing our efforts on OKI-219 for development in particular indications…
